study.question: Does sharing a rank-summary compression map by target-match relation across temporal bins improve joint modeling beyond equally sized banks with balanced window-dependent assignments, a redundant shared map, and the incumbent?
study.hypothesis: Local evidence favors target-relation content over field granularity, while the latest independent timing map loses to a redundant full-moment map. The present model still applies the same 112-to-32 rank projections to every global/item/category/campaign/customer/brand/price relation. A relation-specific compression subspace reused across all five temporal bins may retain different useful directions and pool scarce task evidence more effectively than heterogeneous relations sharing one subspace. This bottleneck and the benefit of semantic sharing are hypotheses, not established observations.

nearest_work.difference: Archived primary text lines272-282 verifies unnormalized target activation and its noisy-sequence caveat. Inherit adapted local activation but preserve overlapping target-relation summaries and rank moments through joint token interaction. No exact DIN reproduction claim.

Pinned benchmark source lines148-159 uses FieldWiseTokenizer/task tokens; lines173-200 uses per-token FFNs after mixing. Heterogeneous transformations are inherited prior ideas. Our changed component is seven bias-free maps on existing rank summaries with relation-consistent sharing across time; retain existing JointBlock, static tokens, DIN bypass and readout. This is a local adaptation, not HiFormer reproduction.

Original paper is registered but detailed text unavailable via registry; provenance is verified, original-paper mechanism and priority are not. No originality claim is made. Pinned benchmark implementation and explicitly labeled benchmark fallback were read.

Pinned constructor selects chunk tokenization after target pooling. Do not replace tokenization with chunks or token mixing; isolate sharing of an existing compressed temporal-relation representation. Partial constructor inspection does not audit the whole method.

Pinned forward lines175-190 flattens history and combines it with user/context before tokenization. Our frozen 35 summaries remain compressed; do not claim equivalence to full-event access or rule out its value.

Pinned imports/constructor use field-wise tokenization and full/window attention settings; only this bounded portion was inspected. No event-token attention is newly adopted; changing sharing of summary compression is a smaller local test.

Direct parent source inspected and inherited. Add C[relation]*M to its A*M+B*M summary, with all C initialized zero. The rotated, shared-mean and inactive controls change only bank sharing/function. This is the closest local reference.

inherited_components: Exact parent embeddings and item/user/action schema; sanitized masked history and forced unknown current action.
Unnormalized DIN target activation and global DIN bypass; global plus four valid-rank quartiles.
Seven overlapping relations (global and six nonpadding target-field equalities); unchanged weighted content and log1p counts.

study.proposed_difference: Append seven zero-initialized dense matrices C[g] of shape[112,32] after all inherited initialization, using no random draws. Before JointBlock add einsum(M[b,t,r,:], C[a(t,r)]) to the same summary token. Main candidate a(t,r)=r reuses each relation map across five bins. Capacity-matched control a(t,r)=(r+t)%7 mixes semantic sharing across bins; each bank has exactly five nominal token uses in either arm, with no movement of tokens or information. Shared control replaces all C by their mean (equal nominal parameters, reduced functional dimension); zero control computes and zeroes the same extra path. All variants add25088 parameters and begin at the parent function. New bank output is bias-free and preserves zero summaries. Count/content projections, moments, windows, masks, tokens, losses and host parameters do not change.
predictions: Principal prediction: relation_bank exceeds rotated_bank on equal-weight four-task validation macro AUC under the same frozen seed and recipe. Greater capacity than the parent alone is not evidence of relation-consistent sharing.

Useful candidate must also exceed shared_bank and zero_bank/archived incumbent by the declared macro-AUC selection rule; all four AUC/Logloss changes against DIN and incumbent will be reported, with exact ties resolved by macro Logloss, parameters and trial ID.

Zero initialization yields equal finite starting predictions in all arms with identical inherited weights. Empty histories and singleton temporal bins have zero direct added moment contribution at any fixed state; downstream trained empty-history predictions can still differ indirectly.

The rotated assignment cannot be undone by one global bank permutation because the same relation uses a different bank in each bin. If all C are identical, relation and rotated outputs agree; if banks differ, relation-local input perturbation reveals the specified window-dependent control routing.

Exploratory localization only: compare existing history bins empty,1-16,17-64,>64 with counts and all-task positives/negatives. If authorized host diagnostics support it, additionally report missing/nonzero relation occupancy and moment magnitude without altering selection. These slices do not select a winning task or establish causation.
falsifiers: A tie or loss against rotated_bank fails the stated relation-consistency prediction for this implementation. If both heterogeneous arms improve equally, infer at most a grouped-projection/capacity effect, not semantic-sharing support.

An improvement only against zero_bank, with no improvement against shared_bank or rotated_bank, is compatible with redundant optimization capacity and does not support the proposed compression mechanism.
No useful macro-AUC gain over zero_bank/parent means do not adopt this candidate for performance even if a routing contrast happens to favor it.

Initialization mismatch, unequal inherited weights/RNG, zero-control replay failure beyond documented numerical tolerance, masked-input sensitivity, invalid outputs or unregistered bank parameters invalidates the scientific contrast; retain failure costs and diagnose before scoring.

Lack of repeatability on paired seeds or user-cluster uncertainty encompassing material reversals weakens a positive screening outcome. A failed arm does not refute all relation-dependent compression designs.
alternative_explanations: Extra maps alter adaptive optimization and dense gradient clipping even without adding function-space dimensions; shared-bank and inactive controls diagnose parts of this explanation.

Relation and rotated arms have equal nominal bank usage, parameters and output shapes, but different effective occupancy, gradient norms and relation co-occurrence. Those are consequences of sharing and cannot be cleanly separated by this single contrast.

Global and relation windows overlap, and target matching includes encoded OOV/missing codes other than padding. Gains may reflect benchmark equality or prevalence artifacts, not real-world identity or causal interests.
Rotated maps can exploit fixed token identities and recover some structure; a null result may indicate sufficient downstream capacity or limited one-pass optimization rather than useless semantics.
Validation reuse, seed variation, BF16 accumulation and winner selection can explain small gains; no significance claim from one seed or repeated deterministic replays.
Official offline delayed feedback and category/brand auxiliary attribution are inherited assumptions. No production point-in-time or advertisement-conversion validity follows.

observations_and_limits.history_review: All31 committed trajectories are successful execution receipts; several scientifically negative/null branches remain recorded. Recency beat pooled slots, but field grouping had interactions with temporal construction; seven replicas outperformed atomic/coordinate partitions. Relation content dominated relation-count-only and replica controls. Explicit joint/independent/marginal feedback count channels did not beat zero feedback counts. Linear rank moment outperformed quadratic/copy/zero; within-only and occupancy-only did not beat full. Untied occupancy map failed to beat duplicate_full, leaving an optimization/capacity explanation. No execution failure is invented and deterministic replays are not seed replication.
observations_and_limits.latest_knowledge_usage_review: Previous study considered HeMix,UniMixer,UltraHSTU,Zenith and executed no newly adopted external mechanism. Its untied timing direction did not beat the active duplicate control. Thus those cards provide provenance/context, not causal support; do not silently carry them forward as used architecture. Current HiFormer-inspired parameter sharing is separately declared and controlled.
